title: Goongɗinal caggal Jappeere
intro: Won e yontaaji jarribaama wonaa e yiite walla e ilam, kono ko e ɓuuɓri leelndi nguurndam e nder galle laamorɗo tiiɗɗo. Ndee ɗoo limre ina darii sara laamɗo gooto wiyɗo ina jogii diine e dow leñol mum, kono e nder sirlu ina jokki e goongɗinde Alla gooto Goonga oo. Nde dewal maɓɓe yiytaa, torraaji ngari — kono noon fodoore Alla ari. Mbele aɗa waawi teskaade hol oo?
clues: Miɗo wuuri les njiimaandi laamɗo leydi am ɓurɗo doole, e darnde nde seeɗa tan waawi miijaade.
Jom suudu am darii yeeso yim6e, hollitii hoore mum ko laamcfo — kono 6ernde am ko Joomiraacfo gooto Goonga oo jeyi.
Miɗo ɓuuɓtoo duwaawu e nder sirlu, miɗo hula jukkungo garoowo e kala ƴattoowo jom suudu am.
Nde gooŋɗinal am feeñi, mi nanngaa, mi torlaa — kono ɗemngal am meeɗaa haalde konngol keewngol.
Mi ruttinii joom am 6ernde am, ñaagiimi galle to Aljanna, wocfcfucfo e kala bonannde.
Miin woni Asiya bint Muzahim — debbo Firawna mo luulndii Muusaa e Haruna.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Joom suudu Firaawna)
Hawwa (Haawa), debbo gadano
Saara, debbo gadano Ibraahiima
Hajara yumma Ismaa'il
Yumma Maryam (jom suudu Imran)

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Muñde torla ngam salaade woppude iimanaagal
Wuurde e nder reedu liɗɗi mawɗi
Mahde laana mawka ngam daɗde e ilam
Wereede e nder yiite ɓuuɓɗo
Seedaade seerndude maayo mawngo
trial.answer: Muñde torla ngam salaade woppude iimanaagal

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Suudu mahaandu e maɓɓe to Aljanna
Sawru wayliima wonti mboddi
Laana njoorndi njoorndi kala tagoore
Nagge kaŋŋe ngel leñol rewata
Sling kuutorteeɗo ngam foolde jaambaaro mawɗo
location.answer: Suudu mahanndu ɓe e nder Aljanna

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Teddinaama e hoɗorde Aljanna e bannge moƴƴuɓe
Njippii les ɓuuɓol wondude e konu maɓɓe
Burned e yiite kono hisnaama e ballal Alla
Muuɗi tagoore mawnde ndeen werlaa e leydi
Wonti neɗɗo ɓurɗo alɗude e jamaanu maɓɓe
outcome.answer: Teddinaama e hoɗorde Aljanna e bannge moƴƴuɓe

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
